evidence: arXiv:1609.06848 (Durieux, Hamadi, Monperrus; v1 2016, v2 2018). Sec.1: 'it uses production oracles (such as uncaught exceptions) to detect failures'; Sec.3.1 shadow traffic; Sec.3.2.5 'We also imagine ... automated pull requests'; patch models NPEFix/Exception-Stopper; 'Itzal does not require a failing test case'.
correction: Venue: arXiv preprint (no conference listed). PRs are only envisioned (prototype uses a web dashboard). Paper says domain-specific oracles (e.g., XML schema) are supported, though evaluation used exception/HTTP oracles.

evidence: SOSP'09, Perkins et al. Abstract: ClearView '(1) observes normal executions to learn invariants... (4) generates candidate repair patches... (5) observes the continued execution of patched applications to select the most successful patch.' Works on stripped Windows x86 binaries; Red Team exercise.
PLDI'07, Novark, Berger, Zorn. Abstract: 'Exterminator enables collaborative bug correction by merging patches generated by multiple users.' Sec. 6.4 'Collaborative Correction'.
correction: Patches are runtime heap-allocation patches for memory errors, not source patches; phrase claim as collaborative merging of runtime patches.

evidence: Engine page: 'Diagnoses the root cause against your traces and connected source code'; scans 'on a dynamic schedule'; 'Open draft pull requests'; 'Engine never merges a pull request'; replay validation '(beta, LangSmith Cloud only)'; Deep Agents, LangChain, LangGraph.
correction: 'No test code described' is an absence claim; page mentions generating dataset examples from traces for offline evaluation.

evidence: 'Anatomy of a pull request' (PostHog self-driving, open beta): PR includes 'a regression test that reproduces the original failure'; agent 'babysits CI until the checks are green' after PR opens; no fail-first requirement stated.
correction: Phrase CI as 'agent babysits CI until green after opening the PR' rather than 'CI fixed'.

evidence: Section 'Tools that fix themselves': 'Tools learn from real production calls and patch without your agent noticing.' Example: GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL 400 invalid_recipient_format, pattern in 12% of calls, 'v2.1.4 published to every agent'. No tests or human review mentioned.

arXiv:2608.19303 (Panthi, Abdelfattah, Aug 2026). Sec.1: 'it never restricts an action, executes a repair, reveals a benchmark fault label, or consults the evaluator'. Sec.5: 'This measures detection, not recovery.' Sec.6: 'Recovery from organic failures remains open.'

'Tusk Drift Overview': 'This replays the inbound API call while intercepting outbound requests and serving them from recorded data.' Cloud correlates deviations to PR changes, labels intended/unintended; 'does root cause analysis, and suggests code fixes.'
